dogecoin.text: If I was in #cryptocurrency strictly for the money, my portfolio would consist of only #BTC & #ETH - I own coins like #SAFEMOON because I like innovation and coins like #dogecoin because I just like the coin.

There are officially way too many #shitcoins out in the market right now. Legit projects like #safemoon and old tried-and-true coins like #dogecoin are getting thrown in the mix when they shouldn’t be. This bubble is going to hurt a lot of people when it pops.
I’m still so shook to see $SHIB surpass $DOGE. Really didn’t see that one coming. Still hold both because I like shibs and I’m not a tribal bastard 📈

After the $DOGE craze earlier this year, the recent $SHIB explosion and the sudden revival of #SAFEMOON, now r/Cryptocurrency is littered with posts of people buying random coins hoping to get the same effect 😂 shouldn’t have talked so much shit about those to begin with 🤷🏽‍♂️
